questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.He reads ________ to analyse the comprehension text.
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given proverb.After victory, tighten your helmet cord
options: Always be cautious, even after achieving success
Celebrate your victory with a sense of pride
It is important to relax after a victory
You should always remain humble in victory
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Always be cautious, even after achieving success) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the following questions.Today, a robust system of physical education plays an increasingly important role in the modern educational system.
